models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.quant: ROCm, IQ4_XS; custom llama.cpp fork streaming the KV cache between VRAM and system RAM; Q4 KV values + Q8 keys; generation at ~20K context (35 t/s at ~200K context); the 658 t/s prefill figure is prompt processing and is not recorded
engines.system_ram_min: 24GB DDR5 (about 16GB used in the reported run)

models.why: RX 9070 XT figures for Qwen3.8-27B in this query's posts name no inference engine, so the ROCm RX 9060 XT llama.cpp run is the AMD measurement carried here.
